t: 苏格兰国王君士坦丁二世,德休巴尔斯国王希韦尔·达达,班堡国王埃尔德雷德和库姆布里亚人国王奥瓦恩…
te: King Constantine II of Scotland, King Hywel Dda of Deheubarth, Ealdred of Bamburgh and King Owain of the Cumbrians acce…
dz: 苏格兰国王君士坦丁二世,德休巴尔斯国王希韦尔·达达,班堡国王埃尔德雷德和库姆布里亚人国王奥瓦恩接受英格兰国王埃瑟尔斯坦的统治,导致北方七年的和平.
de: King Constantine II of Scotland, King Hywel Dda of Deheubarth, Ealdred of Bamburgh and King Owain of the Cumbrians accept the overlordship of King Æthelstan of England, leading to seven years of peace in the north.

t: 萨拉克人征服并摧毁了塔兰托.
te: The Saracens conquer and destroy Taranto.
dz: 萨拉克人征服并摧毁了塔兰托.
de: The Saracens conquer and destroy Taranto.

t: 阿德哈尔巴扬的萨吉德埃米尔优素福·伊本·阿比勒-萨杰被库法附近的卡尔马提人所击败并被俘.
te: The Sajid emir of Adharbayjan, Yusuf ibn Abi'l-Saj is defeated and captured by the Qarmatians near Kufa.
dz: 阿德哈尔巴扬的萨吉德埃米尔优素福·伊本·阿比勒-萨杰被库法附近的卡尔马提人所击败并被俘.
de: The Sajid emir of Adharbayjan, Yusuf ibn Abi'l-Saj is defeated and captured by the Qarmatians near Kufa.
